item.tib: gshin rje khros pa brnag pa las kyi drwa ba'i rgyud las gtso 'khor brgyad cu rtsa gcig gi khrom bskul
item.coloph: ces gshin rje gtso 'khor brgyad cu gya gcig gi khrom bskul chen mo 'di ni/ sems dpa' gsang sngags grags pa rin po che sogs mched grogs dam pa 'ga' yi thugs dgyes su/ snyigs dus kyi rnal 'byor kun grol grags pa bdag gis/ lhun grub dpag bsam ljon pa'i gling du/ me sbrul zla tshes la brtsams pa rgyal bstan gsal ba'i sgron me ru gyur cig//
